description: Builds a data-based comparison profile of a subgroup (segment/persona) versus the rest of the sample from quantitative survey data (CSV): who they are, how they differ, what characterizes them. Result as Markdown to reports/. Use for personas, user types or audience characterization. Invoke with your request as the argument, e.g. /segment-profile <segment, e.g. "daily users" or "Industry=Retail">.
